doc: Read-only named data files the host makes available to the guest (ROMs, WADs, levels). Names are host-defined keys, not file paths.

constants.name: ERR_RANGE
constants.doc: offset is negative or past the end of the asset

functions.name: size
functions.doc: Size of the asset in bytes, or ERR_NOT_FOUND.

functions.name: read
functions.doc: Copies bytes [offset, offset + cap) of the asset (fewer at its end) into dst. Returns the number of bytes copied, or ERR_NOT_FOUND / ERR_RANGE.
